identity: Personal local-first mobile intelligence and action environment
constraints: Android observation is first-class but permission-scoped and sandbox-aware

acquisition: Android app observation: UsageStats/UsageEvents, opt-in notifications, scoped Accessibility, intents/App Links and supported provider interfaces
intelligence: cross-app event correlation and lifecycle reconstruction
execution: native cross-app handoffs and verified supported interactions

donor_repositories.outbound_sourcer: source adapter and discovery pipeline concepts; not product identity
donor_repositories.ebo: event/signal ledger, qualification and approval concepts; no infrastructure dependency
donor_repositories.bos: entity/capability/workflow/policy modeling; not a business OS shell
donor_repositories.troy: source-aware extraction, interpretation and identity resolution
donor_repositories.me: immutable evidence and derived observation concepts; no personal DB import
donor_repositories.memo: selected Android automation, approval and visible-browser patterns; not base product
donor_repositories.busybee: App Observer Lab, Platform Activity Integration, Native Provider Bridge and owned-app plaintext observer research; audit and adapt, never assume arbitrary app internals
donor_repositories.vaultos: local import, indexing, backup and data integrity

event_inspection.unit_of_value: Inspectable evidence-backed fact, object, event, action or change; not an app-open counter.
must_expose: when it happened and when Locco received it
where it happened and its source
what is missing, redacted or inaccessible
what happened next and whether that outcome was verified
rules: every event is clickable and inspectable
never infer a tap from an app-open event
preserve source, acquisition method, timestamps, completeness and confidence
do not fabricate content that Android or the source app does not expose

archive_provenance.keystone_mission_brief: Reconstructed/normalized transcription; not a byte-for-byte export of the original brainstorming.
archive_provenance.structured_json: Derived machine-readable interpretation, not raw source.
archive_provenance.missing_source: The full original user-authored brainstorm was not recoverable in the accessible conversation archive during the 2026-11-27 audit.
archive_provenance.preservation_rule: Future brainstorm inputs must be archived verbatim with source date/provenance before distillation.

environments: first-class native browser and safe DOM observation/Stitching
extensible Model Hub and local intelligence
domain-neutral capability composition and verified execution
